answer: An applicant who owns a delta, owes a karst and outlasted a cedar is an agent; an applicant holding only the first two is a farm in a hurry. Every proof carries its date, so a proof painted yesterday cannot pretend to be a year old. Proof, not promises: Horn cutter horn blank warrant turned on the soaking vat asks for each horn blank is a measured horn yield plus a hornworker's signature, and no farm can supply it honestly. Get caught once and the whole shelf burns: 504 masks, 39312 POA, gone on one grade.
